documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual preventive visit. 33 y/o, 4 months postpartum.

Interval: back at work part-time since January. No headaches, chest pain, palpitations or swelling. Home BPs off medication since late Nov run 106-118/68-76. Sleep still broken but improving. Still taking the prenatal vitamin.

PMH: history of gestational HTN (2021); severe preeclampsia with AKI and retinal changes (10/2024, delivered 35 wk); eclampsia with AKI and retinal changes (10/2025, delivered 34 wk). All resolved, kidney function and fundi normal since.
Meds: prenatal vitamin daily. NKDA.
FH: mother with preeclampsia, father with hypertension.
SH: married, administrative assistant, never smoker, no alcohol. Walks most days.

ROS otherwise negative.

Exam: vitals as charted, BP normal. Well appearing. HEENT normal. Neck supple, no thyroid enlargement or nodules. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Extremities without edema. Skin without concerning lesions. Neuro nonfocal. Mood and affect appropriate. PHQ-9 2, GAD-7 3.

A/P:
1. Health maintenance. Fasting lipids, A1c, CMP, CBC today. Cervical screening up to date (co-test 2023 negative), next due 2028. Flu and Tdap given in Sept. HIV and hep C negative on prenatal labs, no repeat needed.
2. History of preeclampsia/eclampsia. Discussed that two hypertensive pregnancies plus family history put her at higher lifetime risk for hypertension and heart disease. Plan: BP check here every 6 months with home log, yearly lipids and A1c, keep up activity. If she considers another pregnancy, preconception visit here and with OB first.
3. Prenatal vitamin: fine to finish the bottle and stop. Her choice.

RTC 3 months for BP check, yearly physical.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Emily, all your labs are normal. Cholesterol panel is in a healthy range, A1c (3-month sugar average) is normal, kidney and liver function normal, blood counts normal. We'll repeat lipids and A1c next year.

documents.title: Video Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Video visit for BP follow-up, history of preeclampsia and eclampsia.

Pt at home, identity confirmed. Sent 2 weeks of home readings before the visit: 104-120/66-78, average around 112/72. Checked cuff against our office reading in Feb, matched. No headaches, no swelling, no visual symptoms. Feels well. Stopped the prenatal vitamin in March.

Exam limited to video: well appearing, comfortable, speaking easily.

A/P: normotensive off medication 6 months postpartum. Continue home checks once or twice a month. In-office BP in about 4 months, labs at next year's physical. Message with any reading over 135/85.

15 min.
